name: Halohop Skipping Rope with Counter, Adjustable Tangle-Free Rapid Speed Rope
best_for: People who want a speed rope with a built-in counter and bearings for cardio training at home.
pros: A built-in LED counter that the listing says shows a timer, jump count and a calorie estimate
Ball bearings and bearing stabilisers are listed for smooth turning
A steel rope with a PVC sheath, described as tangle free
The 3 m rope can be adjusted by trimming off the extra cord
Handles are described as ABS and non-slip
cons: The length is adjusted by cutting the cord, which cannot be undone
The counter's calorie figure is only an estimate that depends on the weight you enter
The listing offers a rope-only and a ball-plus-rope option, so check which one you are choosing
SAT has not tested it: details are as the seller lists them
features: Backlit LED counter: timer, jumps and calories (as listed)
Steel rope with PVC sheath (as listed)
value_for_money: We do not store prices. Check the current price and the colour or option you want on the Amazon page.
who_should_buy: Skippers who like to see their jump count and time on the handle and are happy to trim the rope to length.
avoid: Anyone who wants a rope they can re-adjust later without cutting, or who does not want electronics in the handle.
how_to_choose: Decide how you want to set the length (trimming is permanent), check the counter display, and pick the rope-only or rope-plus-ball option.
final_recommendation: A counter-equipped steel-wire speed rope; check the length adjustment and the option you are choosing on the listing before ordering.
